patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Linear share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Hive only if your buying job matches “Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — ” rather than Linear's shape. Choose Linear only if your buying job matches “Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo ” rather than Hive's shape. Workflow advantage: Hive leans team-collaboration-work; Linear leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Hive and Linear share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Hive is Work management platform with free plan (≤10 members) and Teams from $12/user/mo annual — strong monday.com peer.; Linear is Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Hive (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Linear (startup, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Hive-leaning team-collaboration-work vs Linear-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Hive — Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Linear — Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS.

Limitations — Hive: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams; Free storage (200MB) and AI credits (1k) are tight for active teams; Linear: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Leaner automation than Jira Enterprise.

Poor-fit cases: Hive is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free and Starter cap members/projects at 10 — growth forces Teams · Linear is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS · Avoid Hive if you actually need Linear's motion (Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
